audit_items.proof_trace: exchange_rate = (cash + debt - cash_reserve) / total_supply; all mutating operations preserve or increase this ratio. mint_ctokens uses floor(collateral/rate) for mint_amount so S·collateral ≥ N·floor(collateral·S/N) guarantees rate non-decrease; burn_ctokens uses floor(rate·c) for redemption so N·c ≥ S·floor(N·c/S) likewise guarantees rate non-decrease; borrow/repay leave the numerator unchanged (ΔN=0); accrue_interest increases numerator by (1-reserve_factor)·interest ≥ 0; flash-loan repayment of principal bypasses self.cash but restores underlying_balance in the same TX leaving cash tracking unchanged.
